panels.title: Viper metrics per file
panels.description: Each row is one viper_metrics column, summarised over all Viper files: min, quartiles, mean, standard deviation, 95th percentile, max and total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.label AS "Metric",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Min", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Min", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Min",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P25", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P25", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P25",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Median", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Median", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Median",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Mean", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Mean", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Mean",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Std dev", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Std dev", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Std dev",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P75", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P75", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P75",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P95", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P95", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P95",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Max", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Max", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Max",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Total", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Total", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Total",
       s.files AS "Files"
FROM (SELECT m.pos, m.label, m.pow2,
       min(m.v) AS "Min",
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P25",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "Median",
       avg(m.v) AS "Mean",
       stddev_samp(m.v) AS "Std dev",
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P75",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P95",
       max(m.v) AS "Max",
       sum(m.v) AS "Total",
       count(m.v) AS files
      FROM viper_metrics,
           LATERAL (VALUES
             (0, 'Lines of code', loc::double precision, false),
       (1, 'Lines', lines::double precision, false),
       (2, 'Bytes', bytes::double precision, false),
       (3, 'Methods', methods::double precision, false),
       (4, 'Functions', functions::double precision, false),
       (5, 'Predicates', predicates::double precision, false),
       (6, 'Domains', domains::double precision, false),
       (7, 'Domain functions', domain_functions::double precision, false),
       (8, 'Axioms', axioms::double precision, false),
       (9, 'Fields', fields::double precision, false),
       (10, 'ADTs', adts::double precision, false),
       (11, 'Statements', stmts::double precision, false),
       (12, 'Expressions', exps::double precision, false),
       (13, 'Folds', folds::double precision, false),
       (14, 'Unfolds', unfolds::double precision, false),
       (15, 'Unfolding expressions', heap_update_exps::double precision, false),
       (16, 'Inhales', inhales::double precision, false),
       (17, 'Exhales', exhales::double precision, false),
       (18, 'Asserts', asserts::double precision, false),
       (19, 'Assumes', assumes::double precision, false),
       (20, 'acc(...)', accs::double precision, false),
       (21, 'Quantifiers', quantifiers::double precision, false),
       (22, 'Labels', labels::double precision, false),
       (23, 'Gotos', gotos::double precision, false),
       (24, 'Ifs', ifs::double precision, false),
       (25, 'Whiles', whiles::double precision, false),
       (26, 'Assignments', assigns::double precision, false),
       (27, 'Method calls', method_calls::double precision, false),
       (28, 'Function applications', function_apps::double precision, false),
       (29, 'old(...)', old_exps::double precision, false),
       (30, 'Contract clauses', contract_clauses::double precision, false)
           ) AS m(pos, label, v, pow2)
      WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR vpr_sha256 IN (SELECT vpr_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
      GROUP BY m.pos, m.label, m.pow2) s
ORDER BY s.pos

panels.title: Viper file size
panels.description: Files per size bucket. Bucket 2ᵏ holds the files with 2ᵏ to 2ᵏ⁺¹ - 1 lines of code (0: empty files), as in the proposal's speedup histogram.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN k < 0 THEN '0'
            ELSE '2' || translate(k::text, '0123456789', '⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹') END AS "Lines of code",
       files AS "Files"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN loc > 0 THEN floor(log(2, loc))::int ELSE -1 END AS k,
             count(*) AS files
      FROM viper_metrics WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR vpr_sha256 IN (SELECT vpr_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) GROUP BY 1) b
ORDER BY k

panels.title: Viper statements by kind
panels.description: Statements of each kind over all Viper files (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.label AS "Kind", sum(m.v) AS "Total"
FROM viper_metrics, LATERAL (VALUES (0, 'Inhale', inhales), (1, 'Exhale', exhales), (2, 'Assert', asserts), (3, 'Assume', assumes), (4, 'Fold', folds), (5, 'Unfold', unfolds), (6, 'Label', labels), (7, 'Goto', gotos), (8, 'If', ifs), (9, 'While', whiles), (10, 'Assignment', assigns), (11, 'Method call', method_calls)) AS m(pos, label, v)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR vpr_sha256 IN (SELECT vpr_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
GROUP BY m.pos, m.label ORDER BY m.pos

panels.title: Viper declarations by kind
panels.description: Top-level declarations of each kind over all Viper files (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.label AS "Kind", sum(m.v) AS "Total"
FROM viper_metrics, LATERAL (VALUES (0, 'Method', methods), (1, 'Function', functions), (2, 'Predicate', predicates), (3, 'Domain', domains), (4, 'Domain function', domain_functions), (5, 'Axiom', axioms), (6, 'Field', fields), (7, 'ADT', adts)) AS m(pos, label, v)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR vpr_sha256 IN (SELECT vpr_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
GROUP BY m.pos, m.label ORDER BY m.pos

panels.title: Viper expressions by kind
panels.description: Expression constructs over all Viper files (log scale).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.label AS "Kind", sum(m.v) AS "Total"
FROM viper_metrics, LATERAL (VALUES (0, 'acc(...)', accs), (1, 'Quantifier', quantifiers), (2, 'Function application', function_apps), (3, 'unfolding ... in', heap_update_exps), (4, 'old(...)', old_exps), (5, 'Contract clause', contract_clauses)) AS m(pos, label, v)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR vpr_sha256 IN (SELECT vpr_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
GROUP BY m.pos, m.label ORDER BY m.pos

panels.title: Rust metrics per file
panels.description: Each row is one rust_metrics column, summarised over all Rust files. Per-function columns are NULL for files without functions and are left out of their row. Control-flow paths grow exponentially and are shown as powers of two (2^x).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.label AS "Metric",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Min", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Min", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Min",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P25", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P25", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P25",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Median", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Median", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Median",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Mean", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Mean", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Mean",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Std dev", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Std dev", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "Std dev",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P75", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P75", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P75",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."P95", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."P95", 'FM999G999G999G999G990D0') END AS "P95",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Max", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Max", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Max",
       CASE WHEN s.pow2 THEN '2^' || to_char(ln(greatest(s."Total", 1)) / ln(2), 'FM99990D0') ELSE to_char(s."Total", 'FM999G999G999G999G990') END AS "Total",
       s.files AS "Files"
FROM (SELECT m.pos, m.label, m.pow2,
       min(m.v) AS "Min",
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P25",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "Median",
       avg(m.v) AS "Mean",
       stddev_samp(m.v) AS "Std dev",
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P75",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.v) AS "P95",
       max(m.v) AS "Max",
       sum(m.v) AS "Total",
       count(m.v) AS files
      FROM rust_metrics,
           LATERAL (VALUES
             (0, 'Lines of code', loc::double precision, false),
       (1, 'Functions', fns::double precision, false),
       (2, 'Structs', structs::double precision, false),
       (3, 'Enums', enums::double precision, false),
       (4, 'Lines in functions', fn_loc::double precision, false),
       (5, 'Control-flow paths', paths::double precision, true),
       (6, 'Statements', stmts::double precision, false),
       (7, 'Expressions', exprs::double precision, false),
       (8, 'Loops', loops::double precision, false),
       (9, 'Ifs', ifs::double precision, false),
       (10, 'Early returns', early_returns::double precision, false),
       (11, 'Matches', matches::double precision, false),
       (12, 'Match arms', match_arms::double precision, false),
       (13, 'Arguments', args::double precision, false),
       (14, 'Calls', calls::double precision, false),
       (15, 'Distinct callees', distinct_callees::double precision, false),
       (16, 'Assignments', assigns::double precision, false),
       (17, 'Writes through &mut', mut_ref_writes::double precision, false),
       (18, 'Reborrows', reborrows::double precision, false),
       (19, 'Arithmetic ops', arith_ops::double precision, false),
       (20, 'Divisions', divisions::double precision, false),
       (21, 'Indexing', indexing::double precision, false),
       (22, 'Casts', casts::double precision, false),
       (23, 'Unwraps', unwraps::double precision, false),
       (24, 'Panics', panics::double precision, false),
       (25, 'Cyclomatic', cyclomatic::double precision, false),
       (26, 'Max loop depth', max_loop_depth::double precision, false),
       (27, 'Max if depth', max_if_depth::double precision, false),
       (28, 'Max branch depth', max_branch_depth::double precision, false),
       (29, 'Max match arms', max_match_arms::double precision, false),
       (30, 'Max call depth', max_call_depth::double precision, false),
       (31, 'Max struct depth', max_struct_depth::double precision, false)
           ) AS m(pos, label, v, pow2)
      WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR rs_sha256 IN (SELECT rs_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
      GROUP BY m.pos, m.label, m.pow2) s
ORDER BY s.pos

panels.title: Rust file size
panels.description: Files per size bucket. Bucket 2ᵏ holds the files with 2ᵏ to 2ᵏ⁺¹ - 1 lines of code (0: empty files).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN k < 0 THEN '0'
            ELSE '2' || translate(k::text, '0123456789', '⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹') END AS "Lines of code",
       files AS "Files"
FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN loc > 0 THEN floor(log(2, loc))::int ELSE -1 END AS k,
             count(*) AS files
      FROM rust_metrics WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR rs_sha256 IN (SELECT rs_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring}))) GROUP BY 1) b
ORDER BY k

panels.title: Checks Rust operations add
panels.description: Operations that add a verification check, over all Rust files.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.label AS "Kind", sum(m.v) AS "Total"
FROM rust_metrics, LATERAL (VALUES (0, 'Arithmetic (overflow)', arith_ops), (1, 'Division (div by zero)', divisions), (2, 'Indexing (bounds)', indexing), (3, 'Cast', casts), (4, 'unwrap/expect', unwraps), (5, 'panic!/assert!', panics)) AS m(pos, label, v)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR rs_sha256 IN (SELECT rs_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
GROUP BY m.pos, m.label ORDER BY m.pos

panels.title: Viper lines per Rust line
panels.description: How much larger Prusti's encoding is: viper_metrics.loc / rust_metrics.loc over linked Rust files.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "Min",
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "P25",
       percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "Median",
       avg(v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "Mean",
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "P75",
       max(v.loc::float / r.loc) AS "Max",
       count(*) AS "Pairs"
FROM rust_metrics r JOIN viper_metrics v USING (vpr_sha256)
WHERE r.loc > 0 AND ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR r.rs_sha256 IN (SELECT rs_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))

panels.title: Rust size vs. Viper size
panels.description: One point per linked Rust file (log scales).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.loc AS "Rust lines of code", v.loc AS "Viper lines of code"
FROM rust_metrics r JOIN viper_metrics v USING (vpr_sha256)
WHERE r.loc > 0 AND v.loc > 0 AND ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR r.rs_sha256 IN (SELECT rs_sha256 FROM benchmarks WHERE suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})))
